26 m2 construidos según registro, 38 según catastro.

Úso como trastero, almacén, etc. 

Se encuentra en la planta sótano del edificio.

Nos encargamos de toda la gestión de la compra.

Llámanos sin compromiso y programaremos una visita.

inv.desc_en:
Storage unit in the center of Madrid, 30 meters from the Gran Vía metro station, opposite Primark.

26 m2 built area according to the land registry, 38 m2 according to the cadastre.

For use as a storage room, warehouse, etc.

Located in the basement of the building.

The real estate agency is not responsible for the items currently in the unit or for its previous use.

We do not charge a commission to the buyer.

High-demand property. Check updated availability on our website, ALCALAINMOBILIARIA.

We handle the entire purchase process.

We also provide our mortgage department completely free of charge to find you the best market conditions.

Do you want to know what your monthly payment would be?

Call us without obligation and we will schedule a visit.

The square footage of the property has been verified according to the cadastre/land registry, where there is a discrepancy.

The furniture shown in the unit is not binding and may not be included.

This advertisement is not binding and may contain errors. It is shown for informational purposes and is not contractual.
